name: OpenFin8
tagline: Secure Post-Quantum-Safe Consent-First Open Finance Platform That Heals and Scales Itself.
pillarsLead: OpenFin8 inherits the Sentin8 security model by construction - the consent ledger, the recipient registry, and every jurisdiction adapter run behind the platform's authorization pipeline, tenant isolation, and post-quantum TLS.

pillars.title: No consent, no data
pillars.summary: Every provider route passes the consent middleware (valid, unexpired, scope-covered) on top of row-level security; revocation stops serving on the very next call - structurally, no bypass exists.

pillars.title: Two ledgers, one truth per side
pillars.summary: The provider's grant ledger and the recipient's consent registry live in separate tenants; no cross-tenant SQL ever. Either institution may run any technology - the only contract is standards-based OAuth.

pillars.title: Data minimization by construction
pillars.summary: Responses are projected to the granted CSDF clusters before serialization - narrowed by scope, product category, and requested fields. Unknown scopes grant nothing.

pillars.title: One kernel, zero forks
pillars.summary: The entire implementation lives in openfin8-core, shared byte-for-byte. Each country adapter contributes its Profile and registration data - adding a market is configuration, not a port.

pillars.title: Licensed specs, never published
pillars.summary: The FDX API specification is licensed and never committed; each adapter's published spec carries OpenFin8-owned routes only, enforced by a CI drift guard. Customers supply their licensed copy.

units.name: OpenFin8:CA
units.summary: Canadian open banking (FDX v6.x, consumer-driven banking): the provider and recipient surfaces over the shared kernel - consent-checked data sharing, money-movement initiation, notifications, certification metrics.

units.name: OpenFin8:US
units.summary: US open banking (FDX v6.x): the identical surface over the same kernel with US identity - independent version cadence, independent enablement.

units.name: OpenFin8:UK
units.summary: UK open banking (OBL Read/Write API v3.1.x): the ASPSP adapter - FAPI 1 Advanced ceremony, intent-based consents, JWS signing, OB Directory trust. In design (OBARCH-5).

sdks.name: openfin8-core
sdks.summary: The open-finance kernel: the consent ledger, recipient registry, CSDF minimization engine, notification worker, and the runtime Profile every jurisdiction identity derives from - embedded by every adapter.

showcaseLead: OpenFin8 contains no platform infrastructure of its own - identity, events, storage, workflows, and scheduling come from the platform services.

showcase.name: Sentin8 - the platform
showcase.summary: 17 services: identity, events, storage, workflows, scheduling - everything OpenFin8 doesn't rebuild.
